newsitem.title: USA: First Chicago says Q4 EPS view not unrealistic.
newsitem.headline: First Chicago says Q4 EPS view not unrealistic.

text.p: First Chicago NBD Corp chairman and chief executive officer Verne Istock said Thursday the consensus analyst estimate calling for fourth quarter earnings of $1.15 a share was not unrealistic.

"I think our position is generally we think the consensus estimates are pretty much in line with what our expectations are," Istock said in an interview. "But we still have another month to go and that's one-third of the period, so I wouldn't put my stamp on that number.
"But we don't think it's an unrealistic one," he said.
The $1.15 figure is the consensus estimate according to First Call Corp, compared to $0.96 a share reported in the fourth quarter of 1995.
Istock would not comment on 1997 earnings estimates, saying the bank had not yet presented its management plan to the board of directors.
First Chicago shares closed down 1-3/8 at 54-7/8 Thursday.
